description: Definability over \(A\) is equivalent to definability over some finite subset of \(A\).
signature:
Set.definable_iff_finitely_definable.{u, v, w, u₁} {M : Type w} {A : Set M} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [L.Structure M]
  {α : Type u₁} {s : Set (α → M)} : A.Definable L s ↔ ∃ A0, ↑A0 ⊆ A ∧ (↑A0).Definable L s
